lines.text: Asaph cries aloud to God, and through the night his outstretched hands do not grow weary.
Asaph remembers God and groans, and he is too troubled to speak.
Asaph asks if God's promise has failed, and says the left hand of the Most High has changed.

wrong_details.wrong: left hand of the Most High
wrong_details.true: right hand of the Most High

lines.text: Asaph will remember the works of the LORD, who redeemed the sons of Moab and Ammon with power.

wrong_details.wrong: the sons of Moab and Ammon
wrong_details.true: the sons of Jacob and Joseph

lines.text: The waters swirled at the sight of God, and He led His people like a flock by Moses and Aaron.
